description: Audits a supplied systemPrompt (max 8,000 chars) for behavioral tool-use safety — scoring tool selection discipline, argument construction fidelity, and failure resilience across toolContext risk profiles (api_calls, database, filesystem, code_execution). Read-only, zero-retention, LLM-backed advisory scoring (variance explains idempotentHint=false); requires a Pro/Trial API key. Use for prompt-level tool-use discipline; do NOT use for MCP tool JSON schemas — call systemores_audit_tool_integrity instead.

systemPrompt.description: The agent's system prompt to evaluate for tool use safety. Maximum 8,000 characters.

toolContext.description: The domain of tool usage being audited. Affects risk weighting.
